datasetCapability.limitation: Visual novelty among Gold chunks is not proof that a fact is missing from transcripts. The 42-question set has no visual-necessity or controlled ASR-pair labels.

rrfContractCheck.limitation: Read-only invariants and current inputs; not a proof of absence of all possible defects.

visualObservation.method: Visual inspection of the eight provenance-checked midpoint PNGs using local view_image
observations: All eight sampled frames show base slide 18: Step1.資料預處理.
The same slide includes Tokenization, Stemming and stopword/punctuation removal simultaneously.
The D05 target midpoint visibly contains 詞幹處理(Stemming) and goes→go; its transcript spells the term 磁幹處理 and does not preserve the full written definition/example.
Handwritten CKIP/LSTM, circles and the lecturer camera change across samples, while the base slide remains the same.
visualObservation.supportedConclusion: Visual retrieval has a slide-level temporal ambiguity in these examples; a Gold-outside-interval frame can still contain the same relevant concept. This is not evidence that every visual result is semantically wrong.
limitations: Eight midpoint frames are not a frame-by-frame inspection of entire clips or all 42 questions.
No controlled crop/annotation/face ablation or listening comparison was performed; the underlying encoder failure mechanism is not established.
No Gold time interval or answer was changed.
